topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can't believe this, it's like someone swiped your idea right out from under you. It’s got to be some kind of mistake, right? We need to dig deeper, see if there’s a way around this. You’ve put so much time, so much heart into this, and it can’t just be over. Maybe there’s a detail, a unique twist we haven’t thought of that can still make it yours. We can’t just give up, not now. Let’s find a way to fight this, or at least find a path that’s still yours. This isn’t the end, it can’t be. We’ve got to keep moving, keep thinking. There’s got to be something we can do.
